name: Earth corner 90 deg concave (3 faces)

joins.grid: pivot (0,0,0) = centre of the 4x4 m corner cell; the two wall centre lines run on y = +2 (arm along X) and x = +2 (arm along Y); room side = toward the pivot (-X/-Y quadrant); inside corner is a concave 3-face bay (two arms + 45-degree face)
joins.arm_x_end: flat plane x = -2.0; profile (y,z): (2.40,0) (2.44,4.0) (1.44,4.0) (1.60,0)  = AN01 end profile shifted to y=+2
joins.arm_y_end: flat plane y = -2.0; profile (x,z): (2.40,0) (2.40,4.0) (1.44,4.0) (1.60,0) = AN01 end profile rotated 90 deg, centre line x=+2
joins.snap: AN01 wall at (x=-4, y=+2, rot 0) meets arm_x_end; AN01 wall at (x=+2, y=-4, rot Z -90 deg so its front faces -X) meets arm_y_end. Outside corner: use the same piece from the back (convex earth mass).

notes: wall section swept along an L with a 45-degree chamfer: one big concave bay over three faces, brow higher and overhanging toward the corner; back = convex rounded earth mass; rubble heap at the foot; dressed like AN01 (pebbles, clods, ledges, ribs, cracks, burrows, root tips, rootlets, drips, husks); bottom flat.
